look_here_first: Measure an intact OPEN flower: perianth about 2.5–5.5 cm total, far shorter than the 7–17 cm tube of A. longiflora. Check broadly triangular or delta-ovate leaves with usually truncate, rounded or somewhat heart-shaped bases; confirm ripe anthocarp ribs and small summit knobs. Tiny closed flowers are not comparable to fully open flowers.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Perennial low-spreading or prostrate, sometimes scrambling branched herb or subshrub; flowering shoots can ascend or climb.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Mostly opposite, often unequal pairs; blades generally delta-shaped to broadly delta-ovate, with truncate to rounded or shallowly cordate bases; margins mostly flat to slightly wavy.

key_traits.label: Open flower
key_traits.text: Petaloid fused perianth, not a separate corolla; fully open perianth about 2.5–5.5 cm overall, narrow tube about 1–2 mm in diameter, spreading limb about 13–25 mm across.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: One-seeded anthocarp about 5–8 mm, with five ribs and deeper paired grooves ending in small inconspicuous glandless knobs; fruit length overlaps A. longiflora.

key_traits.label: Reproduction
key_traits.text: Solitary flowers or small 2–5-flowered cymes, and reduced cleistogamous flowers; presence of only closed flowers can conceal the larger trumpet.
